header.name: Villages
header.description: Four peoples with villages of their own that generate in the world: stonefolk in the hills, reedfolk on stilts in the marsh, tinkers on the savanna, tallfolk on the plains. Every person is anchored to a job post in their village.

modules.description: Villages: peoples, job posts, structures and worldgen

settings.text: A worker takes a trade from the blocks round its post: among trees it is a lumberjack, beside farmland a farmer, at a vein a miner, by open water a fisher. Each cycle it walks to its work, does it, and puts what it made in the nearest chest.
Wages: a cycle costs the worker one food item from its chest. An unpaid lumberjack or miner waits; a farmer or fisher works regardless, since they are what fill the chest.
Workers are paid from their chest
